notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.4.7 — Easier to find your way

• A simpler sidebar: AI Factory, Inbox and Agents first. Everything else is under More — one click away, closed until you open it, and open by itself on any of its pages. Nothing was removed.
• Every Work Item opens on its Next step: what to do now, in plain words, with the one button for it (Review PR, Answer, Run again, Install Lima, Resume) — or, while Vekrun works, what it is doing and that you'll hear from it in the Inbox. The other actions are under More actions.
• The AI Factory page has a Start here checklist until you're set up: connect a coding agent, open a project, describe what you want.
• The Vekrun agent gets a local model by itself: the first one you download, or the best installed one for coding when it has none. It's shown as local in Routing with its own model, and Local only can route work to it; one local model serves both it and Codex unless you name another.
• Fixed: production monitoring through AppSignal's browser sign-in stopped with "missing required argument context" after AppSignal changed its tools. Vekrun now fills purpose fields a server starts requiring.
• Codex sign-in that can't finish (an older Codex inside Vekrun's sandbox: "Token exchange error") now says so and offers Update Codex, then signs in again; a "State mismatch" from an older sign-in link is explained too.
• Fixed: "How models are chosen" in Model choice showed one letter per line; Production monitoring's issue panel scrolled sideways.
